steps.leader: Left foot steps back, small step, ball of the foot on the floor

steps.follower: Weight forward onto the left foot
steps.leader: Weight forward onto the right foot
Left foot beside right
Quick right, almost in place
Left again
Right foot steps in place
Quick left
Right again, left foot free for the next rock step

summary: The foundation of every 6-count move: rock step, triple step, triple step, danced together in closed position.
tips:
Keep the rock step small: about half a foot length.
Triple steps happen almost in place, under your body.
Pulse down softly from the knees on every beat.
Lead the rock step with your frame, not by pulling with your arms.
Right hand flat on her shoulder blade; left hand at her shoulder height, elbow pointing down.
title: Closed basic

steps.follower: Right foot back, together with the leader
steps.leader: Rock step back on the left; frame moves back as one unit
Weight onto right; turn chest and right toe slightly right

steps.follower: Triple step backwards, away from the leader
steps.leader: Left in place; right hand gently guides her away
Quick right; release the right hand

steps.follower: Square up to face the leader
steps.leader: Left in place, square up; left hand carries the connection
Right in place, keep your frame
Quick left, arm relaxed, elbow slightly bent
Right; you are in open position

summary: From closed position, send the follower out to arm's length so you end in open position, one hand connected.
tips:
The lead comes from the chest turn on 2, not from pushing.
Your feet stay home while she travels.
Don't lock the elbow in open position; hold her hand lightly, like a cup.
title: Send out

steps.follower: Right foot back, match the stretch
steps.leader: Left foot back, lean back slightly, feel the stretch
Weight forward onto right, elbow softens
Left steps slightly forward
Quick right
Left, most compression: elbow bent, hand in front of you
Right steps back towards home
Quick left
Right, home, ready for the next stretch

summary: The basic in open position, connected by one hand. The stretch on the rock step is the connection you lead everything else with.
tips:
Light stretch on 1, light compression around 4.
The arm works like a spring: some give, never limp, never stiff.
title: Open basic

steps.follower: Right foot back, matching the stretch
steps.leader: Left foot back; the stretch builds energy

steps.follower: Weight onto left, start moving forward
steps.leader: Weight onto right; bend the left elbow slightly to invite her in

steps.follower: Triple step forward towards the leader
steps.leader: Left in place; draw the left hand towards your center
Quick right; open your right arm to receive her

steps.follower: Arrive slightly to the leader's right side
steps.leader: Left in place; right hand lands softly on her back
Right in place, closed frame
Quick left
Right; back in closed position

summary: From open position, bring the follower back into closed position.
tips:
The rebound from the stretch brings her in; don't pull.
Prepare the right arm early so she arrives into it.
She ends slightly offset to your right, so your feet don't collide.
title: Bring in

steps.follower: Rock step back on the right
steps.leader: Rock step back on the left, normal open stretch

steps.follower: Weight onto left; feel the hand rise
steps.leader: Weight onto right; start lifting the left hand (the signal)

steps.follower: Triple step forward past the leader's right side
steps.leader: Triple step to your left, out of her path; hand above her head

steps.follower: Start turning right under the arm
steps.leader: Keep turning left; hand draws a small circle

steps.follower: Turn right, arm bent, hand near the forehead
steps.leader: Halfway around; loose hold so her hand rotates in yours

steps.follower: Finish the turn, face the leader
steps.leader: Lower the hand to chest height
Settle into your new spot

steps.follower: On the leader's old spot, ready for 1
steps.leader: On her old spot, facing her in open

summary: Partners swap places: the follower turns to her right under the leader's raised left hand while the leader walks around her to the left.
tips:
Lift on 2, not on 3; a late signal makes the turn a scramble.
Get out of her path with a curve to your left.
Make a halo, not a crank: never grip and twist her hand.
Dance it twice in a row to return to your original spots.
title: Underarm pass
